mechanism: Distillation of multi-agent trajectories into a single 7B model via agent-wise LoRA fine-tuning
evidence_scope: we propose a role-aligned supervised fine-tuning pipeline that equips a single 7B backbone with specialized behavior for four agents via lightweight LoRA adapters.
evidence_role: Our contribution is a novel, three-pillar methodology that synergistically generates, refines, and encodes multi-agent knowledge
